## Project Structure

```{=html}
<!-- DRAFT: Show the actual directory tree and explain the reasoning.
     This is one of the highest-value sections — most tutorials skip it
     or use a flat structure. Show how you organize for a project that
     has 20+ files, not 3. -->
```

```         
# PLACEHOLDER — replace with your actual tree
project-root/
├── app/
│   ├── api/
│   │   ├── routes/
│   │   │   ├── __init__.py
│   │   │   ├── auth.py
│   │   │   ├── users.py
│   │   │   └── items.py           # or whatever your domain is
│   │   └── dependencies.py         # shared deps (get_db, get_current_user)
│   ├── core/
│   │   ├── config.py               # settings via pydantic-settings
│   │   ├── security.py             # password hashing, JWT logic
│   │   └── database.py             # engine, session factory
│   ├── models/                     # SQLAlchemy models
│   ├── schemas/                    # Pydantic request/response models
│   ├── repositories/               # data access layer
│   ├── services/                   # business logic
│   └── main.py
├── migrations/                     # Alembic
├── tests/
│   ├── unit/
│   ├── integration/
│   └── conftest.py                 # fixtures, factories, test db
├── docker-compose.yml
├── Dockerfile
├── .github/workflows/
└── pyproject.toml
```
